facts.kind: [Fact], [Test] or [TestMethod] methods in a test project (one referencing Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk)

action-pinning.message: all 6 actions are pinned to a commit

ci-lint.message: CI lints its configuration (GitHub Actions: actionlint, zizmor)

ci-present.message: CI configuration found for GitHub Actions

code-formatting.message: .editorconfig is defined and CI runs dotnet format

compiler-warnings.message: strict .NET analyzer settings are enabled: AnalysisMode Recommended or All, EnforceCodeStyleInBuild, Nullable enable

copy-paste-detection.message: CI runs copy-paste detection with jscpd

coverage.message: branch coverage is reported with coverlet

dependency-audit.message: CI audits the dependencies with NuGet audit of every package

dependency-management.message: dependencies are declared in Directory.Build.props, tests/App.Tests/App.Tests.csproj (NuGet) and locked in src/App/packages.lock.json, tests/App.Tests/packages.lock.json

dependency-updates.message: automated dependency updates are configured with Dependabot

function-limits.message: function length is limited with lizard

large-files.message: no committed file is larger than 5 MiB

license.message: the project is licensed under MIT

platform-matrix.message: CI covers 3 OS(es) (linux, macos, windows), 2 .NET SDK version(s) (10.0.x, 9.0.x), 6 combination(s)

secret-scanning.message: secrets are scanned for with gitleaks

security-policy.message: SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability

security-scanning.message: CI scans the code for security problems with .NET security analyzers

status-badges.message: README.md shows CI (GitHub Actions) and quality (Codecov) badges

warnings-as-errors.message: warnings are treated as errors with TreatWarningsAsErrors
